  -- Thought: Despite IMDb timeouts, multiple sources (TMDB, search snippets from Wikipedia, AsianWiki, etc.) consistently described the film's subject.
  -- Result: Identified the film's subject as a Joseon-era romance involving a scholar and a royal woman, with minor discrepancies in the exact title of the royal love interest.
